contents:
Studio product photograph, single hero object. A men's mechanical wristwatch resting at a 15-degree tilt on a slab of honed dark grey slate, strap partly unfolded toward the camera.

OBJECT AND MATERIALS. 40mm brushed stainless steel case with polished chamfered bezel edges: the radial brushing shows fine directional grain under the key light while the chamfers read as bright specular lines. Deep blue sunburst dial with applied polished indices: the sunburst sheen rotates with the light angle, brightening along the radial grain. Printed white minute track with crisp, correctly kerned typography. Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating: transmits cleanly with a faint blue-violet cast at glancing angle. Vegetable-tanned brown leather strap with cream saddle stitching: broad diffuse scatter with micro-specular on the raised grain, darkening where the leather folds at the spring bars. One stitch sits fractionally tighter than its neighbours, and a hairline handling mark crosses the clasp, visible only in the specular band. Slab of honed dark grey slate: returns a dim diffuse double, never a mirror image.

CAMERA AND OPTICS. Fujifilm GFX100 II, 120mm at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 100. Camera 10 degrees above the dial plane, 0.6 metres from the subject. Focal plane on the dial centre; the strap tail softens progressively; the far edge of the slate softens progressively. 120mm macro on medium format holds the case geometry without wide-angle distortion of the bezel. Bokeh is progressive falloff behind the dial plane with no swirl at the frame edge.

LIGHTING. Key is a 90 by 30 centimetre strip softbox overhead camera-left, at 45 degrees azimuth and 70 degrees above the dial plane, 0.7 metres away, feathered so its reflection lands on the crystal as one continuous soft-edged white band running upper-left to lower-right, never a hotspot, producing a soft-edged shadow with a 1 to 2 centimetre penumbra across the slate away from the case. Fill is a large white card camera-right, at 300 degrees azimuth and at the dial plane, 0.5 metres away, holding the key-to-fill ratio at 4:1. A black flag below the camera line deepens the near chamfer into a defined dark gradient. The cast shadow falls down and camera-right from the overhead key, consistent for the case, the strap and the slate. The contact shadow under the case is tight and dense, opening into a soft penumbra across the slate.

REFLECTION GEOMETRY. The polished bezel carries a legible, geometrically correct reflection of the strip light; the brushed flanks scatter it into a broad directional sheen; the applied indices return a compressed image of the strip softbox; one continuous soft-edged band from the strip softbox, nothing else; a dim diffuse double of the case, no legible detail. Nothing in the reflections implies a light source that is not declared.

COLOUR AND RENDER. Neutral digital profile, no film emulation. Gradual highlight rolloff on the chamfers with no clipped whites. Deepest shadow under the case near 5 percent luminance. Very fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 100.

FRAME. Hero object centred with the strap tail leading toward the lower-right corner. Roughly 12 percent margin above the case.

CAPTURE REALITY. A single mote of dust rests on the slate 3 centimetres from the strap, just outside critical focus. The hands are set at 10:09 with the seconds hand caught mid-sweep between markers. A single frame from a commercial product session.

AVOID: 3D render, CGI look, floating object without contact shadow, blown specular hotspot on the crystal, impossibly clean surfaces, mirror-perfect reflection symmetry, deformed dial typography, oversharpened edges, watermark, text overlay.
